faqs.question: How can I start a conversation?
faqs.answer: Send a message through the contact form or use the contact links on the profile. Include your needs, a brief scope, and information you are allowed to share to start the conversation.

faqs.question: Where can I explore your projects and contributions?
faqs.answer: Visit the projects section and select View details. Each case study provides space for the challenge, approach, technologies, results, and personal contribution. Sample projects carry a demo label.

faqs.question: Is the portfolio available in two languages?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use the ID or EN buttons at the top of the page to choose Bahasa Indonesia or English.

faqs.question: How can I access the CV or certification evidence?
faqs.answer: Available documents can be accessed through the CV button or the links on certification cards. If a document you need is not available yet, please use the contact form.
